title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. For each fold, one part is used as the validation set, and the remaining $$7$$ parts are used for training.

title: Hyperparameter Tuning
text: When tuning a hyperparameter, you test multiple values to find the best one. In this case, you are testing $$11$$ different values of the hyperparameter.

title: Calculating Total Models
text: For each fold in the cross-validation, you need to fit a model for each hyperparameter value. How many models do you fit per fold?

title: Total Models Across All Folds
text: If you fit $$11$$ models per fold, and there are $$8$$ folds, how many models do you fit in total?

title: Final Answer
text: The total number of models you need to fit is the product of the number of folds and the number of hyperparameter values.
